verdict.rationale: Hightouch documents syncs that run on a schedule or a trigger you set, or when data changes. It also offers no-code automated journeys and collects behavioral events (track, identify, and similar). Together these imply event-driven automation, but the evidence never describes defining conditional rules that fire actions directly on incoming events. Missing for 10: explicit docs on event-triggered journey or rule configuration (trigger conditions, action types), real-time event-to-action latency details, and independent hands-on corroboration.
